description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Coinflow is seeking a Software Engineer to design and build reliable, scalable products for merchants and partners. The role develops features for payments, dashboards, and customer portals and contributes across the software development lifecycle.
Software Engineer developing product features across payments, dashboards, and customer portals from design through launch

Responsibilities:
• Develop new features and enhancements for key product areas, such as payments, dashboards, and customer portals
• Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design to implementation and launch
• Work closely with product and design teams to ensure solutions meet customer needs
• Write clean, maintainable code and support engineering best practices
• Help troubleshoot and resolve technical issues as they arise

Requirements:
• 1+ year of experience as a software engineer
• Experience with TypeScript/Node
• A passion for delivering high-quality software that makes users' lives easier
• Comfort with modern development workflows, including code review and CI/CD
• Strong teamwork and communication skills
• Proactive and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment

Preferred:
• preferably building customer-facing products
• additional familiarity with Go, Rust, or Python
